risk_summary: The disclosure quantifies occupancy, lease expirations, receivable allowances, and selected liquidity needs, but relies heavily on standard forward-looking disclaimers and conditional language. Key risks include declining occupancy and rents, tenant defaults, refinancing constraints, inflation, rising rates, pandemic effects, and development cost or execution risk. Overall tone is cautiously negative on operating conditions while asserting confidence in asset quality and balance-sheet strength.
